feature_description: Number Block Management (NBM) handles the lifecycle of thousand-number blocks (RNB - Rufnummernblock) in the RNVS system. This includes BNetzA regulatory assignments (KCODE 20-26), ownership transfers between telecommunications operators, capacity management, and block allocation/deallocation. NBM ensures compliance with German Federal Network Agency regulations and coordinates number block inventory across the telecommunications network.

scope.primary_focus: BNetzA KCODE message processing and number block lifecycle management including validation, persistence, and TNB operator coordination
included_processes: New Assignment (KCODE 20) - BNetzA assigns new blocks to operators
Owner Change (KCODE 21) - Transfer block ownership between operators
PMR error handling for invalid KCODE messages
scope.excluded_scope: Fusion operations (KCODE 60/61), 11-digit migration functionality, individual callnumber management (FCM feature), number porting workflows (PRT feature)

business_context.customer_impact: Affects telecommunications providers managing number allocations. Failed block assignments prevent new number ranges from being used. Ownership transfer failures block carrier changes.

sources.user_input: User requested: 'I want to analyze number block management, specifically how RNVS handles BNetzA assignments with KCODE 20-26. Include PMR error handling but exclude fusion and 11-digit migration.'
